analyst_view.overall: Third-placed Ajax (25 pts) host ADO Den Haag (17th, 9 pts) in Maurice Steijn's first game as ADO coach; ADO have not beaten Ajax in 20 meetings. What changed since this morning: Goal, Voetbalprimeur and Soccernews (21 Nov) now all expect Julian Brandt on the bench, not fit enough to start, likely eased in with a short spell before next week's Klassieker; Berghuis, Kehrer and Gaaei are back, with Kehrer and Amrabat expected to start. The numbers take Brandt off completely (-13% for Ajax goals); Dolberg (season), Tsygankov and Adingra remain out. ADO miss only Luka Reischl according to their fan site, with keeper Nikiema and Pascal Mulder fit, so Pozo, listed as injured in the brief, may be back. Referee Erwin Blank's slightly low card rate is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals with Brandt taken off completely (-13% for Ajax, about -0.3 goals). He is now expected only off the bench rather than starting, so I give back much less than this morning: a short Brandt spell plus Berghuis available, partly offset by Steijn wanting ADO compact in his first game; +2% to about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners, with Ajax's slightly low recent count and ADO's normal output already counted. Ajax will have most of the ball and ADO will sit deep under Steijn, which the 6.7 home corners already reflect, so I stay at 9.8.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards, already nudged up for both sides' recent cards and down for Erwin Blank's lighter touch (-5%). No suspensions or flashpoints are reported, so I stay at 3.5.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.1 shots, already up for Ajax's recent volume (+9%) and ADO's (+7%). Amrabat and Kehrer back in the side and Brandt and Berghuis on the bench add quality more than volume, and a compact ADO under Steijn may shoot less, so I stay at 34.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 shots on target with Brandt ruled out. This morning I nudged this up because he was expected to start; three outlets now have him on the bench, so a short spell adds little and I drop back to 10.5.
